_comment: Legacy OpenCode V1 stdio template. For OpenCode V2, prefer opencode-v2-http.json. V1 uses top-level mcp.porter and the environment field for process variables. HOW TO APPLY: merge the mcp.porter block into your V1 project opencode.json or existing global config. Replace {{PORTER_TOKEN}} and {{PORTER_JWT_SECRET}}, the matching database credentials, embedder URL and repository path. Make Porter importable in the configured Python environment. Official V1 MCP fields reviewed 2026-10-22; this legacy template has not been tested in an installed V1 client.
